title: AI_ORCHESTRA Status
description: Current orchestration state of a single run, owned and updated by the Supervisor.

task_id.description: Identifier of the task this status belongs to.

state.description: Current state in the orchestration state machine.

correction_round.description: Number of correction cycles already consumed.

worker_calls.description: Number of worker agent invocations already made.

reviewer_calls.description: Number of reviewer agent invocations already made.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last state update.

started_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the run was created.

total_tokens.description: Observed token consumption for the run, when available.

reason.description: Optional explanation for the current state, for example an escalation reason.
